issues.where: Milky Way sky and inner ring gap (crops B, E, H of image-05.png; also image-07.png crops J, K, Q)
issues.what: the Milky Way background is a blurry, diagonally stretched low-resolution texture whose stars are large soft orange and white blobs mixed beneath sharp 1-pixel point stars, and in crop E the bright blob cluster stops in a hard elliptical cutoff at the inner C-ring edge
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution equirectangular skybox with native-sharp starfield rendering, and give the inner C-ring a gradual optical-depth falloff so background stars attenuate smoothly

issues.where: lower-left sunlit limb and inner C-ring gap (crop G; also image-03.png crop P and image-07.png crop O)
issues.what: a detached, doubled orange glow edge curves out from Saturn's lower-left limb across the dark inner ring gap while the sunlit limb silhouette itself is visibly stair-stepped
issues.fix: remove the clipped outer atmosphere shell or post-glow boundary, use a continuous volumetric limb falloff, and anti-alias the planet limb with higher supersampling

issues.where: outer left A-ring edge and thin outer ringlets (crop F; also image-02.png crop F, image-03.png crop O, image-07.png crop N, and image-08.png crop S)
issues.what: the outer ring edge and thin Encke and F-ring ringlets break into jagged stair-stepped pixels, with a bright cyan-white doubled rim halo along the outer A-ring boundary
issues.fix: apply anisotropic radial filtering and higher multisample anti-aliasing on the ring plane, and eliminate the bright edge-fringe shader artifact on the outer A-ring

issues.where: lower-left outer A-ring between Cassini division and Encke gap (crop S; also image-06.png crop D, image-02.png crop D, and image-04.png crop U)
issues.what: a straight pale radial seam cuts perpendicular across the concentric ring bands where the ring texture wraps
issues.fix: make any angular ring modulation seamless across the 0-to-1 UV wrap or evaluate ring bands purely from radial distance without an angular UV seam

issues.where: upper-right orange moon (crop M of image-01.png; also image-07.png crop L of image-05.png)
issues.what: the moon's sunlit limb is a hard, jagged stair-stepped pixel edge with no atmospheric haze falloff, and its surface has smooth airbrushed band shading that looks plastic
issues.fix: anti-alias the moon silhouette and render Titan's soft optical haze layer with subtler, less airbrushed surface shading

issues.where: lower-right dark ring-lit limb of Saturn (crop P; also image-03.png crop Q)
issues.what: an uneven, scalloped blue-grey rim halo outlines the dark lower-right globe edge with a hard outer cutoff over the rings, and the faintly lit nightside clouds show coarse color blotching and banding
issues.fix: compute dark-limb atmosphere scattering on high-subdivision geometry in 16-bit or 32-bit float with dithering, and fix the compositing falloff where the dark limb overlaps the rings

issues.where: lower-right dark sky and upper-left sky corner of image-01.png (crops W and X, and image-03.png crop J)
issues.what: stray horizontal blue-grey flare bands streak across the dark lower-right sky well below the sunlit globe, and the upper-left corner haze shows subtle gradient banding
issues.fix: remove unmotivated horizontal flare bars and dither subtle sky gradients before 8-bit output

issues.where: north polar cap and upper-left sunlit limb (crops K and L; also image-07.png crops J and K)
issues.what: the center of the blue north polar vortex shows fine noisy pixel stippling from polar convergence, the bright upper-left limb is slightly stair-stepped beneath a thin uniform rim line, and background stars shine undimmed beside the sunlit limb in image-07.png crop J
issues.fix: remap the polar cap in polar coordinates to avoid pole stippling, anti-alias and soften the upper sunlit limb, and attenuate faint background stars inside bright limb glare

issues.where: ring crops D, G, and A
issues.what: ring debris reads as smooth pills and disc sprites, not irregular ice, and the same props show in image-09.png and image-12.png
issues.fix: replace the sprites with irregular ice chunks that sit in the ring plane, vary in size, and share the ring's blur

issues.what: at native size the clouds are soft painted noise and laminar ribbons, with the same painted bands in image-11.png panels L and M
issues.fix: add fine shear and convective detail so the bands stay sharp in a native crop

issues.what: the streaks go soft and brushed at native size, and panel A in image-14.png does the same
issues.fix: carry the finer turbulence from the lit limb through the mid-latitude bands

issues.what: the hood is a stack of perfectly circular bands, a mild mapping tell, though the pole is not pinched
issues.fix: break the circles with irregular storm texture so the hood is not a set of perfect rings

issues.where: tight ring curves in panels F and H
issues.what: high-contrast ring edges show mild stair-stepping
issues.fix: antialias the ring edges so the curves do not step at native size
